title: Working with Relève
sub: How working through Relève works, how to use the app, and what your days will look like with your client. Read it in order. Your place saves as you go.
time: About an hour and a half
parts: What Relève is, and the people around you
Your status, pay, hours and the agreement
Setup, tasks, messages and your reports
Your first days, a good week, and our standards
